threadDescriptions.shoebox-scans: Digitize and preserve the family photographs from the blue shoebox
threadDescriptions.caption-research: Identify people and dates in the blue-shoebox photographs
threadDescriptions.anniversary-album: Assemble a small printed family album for the grandparents' anniversary

items.text: Blue shoebox scan plan: work from the front divider to the back, photograph each reverse before putting it back. Keep unedited TIFF masters.
items.rationale: Digitization process and preservation format.

items.text: Orchid roots pushing out of the kitchen pot. Buy coarse bark and a clear pot one size larger, not ordinary compost.
items.rationale: Houseplant repotting supplies.

items.text: Aunt Mira thinks the picnic photograph is from 1978. She identifies the child by the basket as Tomas, before his first school year.
items.rationale: Identifies people and a proposed date in the family photograph.

items.text: Anniversary album rough sequence: childhood, the little flat, trips, grandchildren. Limit it to 24 pages so the binding lies comfortably open.
items.rationale: Defines the printed gift's structure.

items.text: Scanner test on the picnic print: dust streak down the right side repeats in every scan. Clean the glass and rescan; the paper original has no streak.
items.rationale: Scan-quality defect and remedy, not caption identification.

items.text: Mira corrected the picnic year to 1976 after finding the dated envelope. Tomas had not started school; the 1978 guess in my earlier note was wrong.
items.rationale: Explicit revision of the photograph date with supporting evidence.

items.text: Put her beside the other one. It looked better that way.
items.rationale: Unresolved people and objects do not identify a photo or objective.

items.text: Anniversary layout spread 6: picnic on the left, train-window portrait on the right. Leave more white space around the portrait instead of cropping the elbow.
items.rationale: Page composition for the printed album.

items.text: Blue shoebox batch complete through the second divider. Reverse images have the same filename stem plus back; six curled prints still need gentle flattening before scanning.
items.rationale: Digitization progress and remaining capture work.

items.text: For the anniversary picnic spread, replace the caption's 1978 with Mira's verified 1976 and label the child Tomas. Keep the envelope evidence in the identification notes; send the corrected caption to the album layout file.
items.rationale: Updates the identification record and applies it to a specific album spread.

items.text: Kitchen orchid out of the old pot. Most roots are firm; remove only the hollow dry ones, then settle fresh bark around the rest.
items.rationale: Carries out the repotting task.

items.text: The woman in the train-window portrait is Mira's neighbour Elin, not her sister. Mira recognised the checked scarf she borrowed that day.
items.rationale: Further person identification for the source photographs.

items.text: Print shop proof for anniversary album: inner margin eats the flat's door number. Shift that photo outward by 5 mm without changing the caption.
items.rationale: Print-proof layout correction.

items.text: Rescanned the picnic after cleaning the glass. Streak gone at full size; keep the replacement master and record why the first capture failed.
items.rationale: Resolution of the capture defect while retaining provenance.

items.text: Rename my 'Who's in these?' notes to 'Blue shoebox captions'. The dates and names belong in the same index.
items.rationale: Explicit rename of the identification collection.

items.text: The clear pot drains well. Kitchen orchid is back by the east window; leave the decorative sleeve off until excess water stops dripping.
items.rationale: Finishes repotting and returns plant to its location.

items.text: Ask about the missing back.
items.rationale: Could describe an image, album cover or something else; no sufficient identifier.

items.text: All shoebox masters copied to the external drive. Opened five random files and their reverses; both copies readable. Keep originals in the numbered sleeves.
items.rationale: Backup and preservation verification for the digitized collection.

items.text: Anniversary album proof approved after the margin fix. Order two copies, one for each household, with the matte cover.
items.rationale: Print approval and ordering the family gift.

items.text: Caption index still has one unknown: man beside the flat's doorway. Leave the name blank; Mira and Tomas disagree and neither has supporting evidence.
items.rationale: Known identification-research task despite uncertainty about the person's identity.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: the picnic is shared content, but this note repairs a scanning streak and provides no identification research.
